note: Free-tier facts as found on 2026-11-20. 'source' says where each number came from; 'measured' is what our own benchmark saw. omnirouteId is the id `omniroute providers add <id>` takes.

providers.name: Groq
providers.measured: gpt-oss-120b 54/57 on the 57-task exam, 0 rate limits in 114K tokens; gpt-oss-20b hit the 200K tokens/day cap on 2026-09-29
providers.plain: Fast. About 1,000 requests a day for free.

providers.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
providers.source: community list (cheahjs/free-llm-api-resources); Google publishes no fixed numbers; daily reset midnight Pacific
providers.measured: flash-lite 49/57, 0 rate limits in 243K tokens; flash-latest blocked by a 30 min cooldown on 2026-11-20
providers.plain: Just needs a Google account. About 10 requests a minute; daily amount not published.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)

limits.all models: 40 req/min; prototyping credits, increases not granted on free accounts

providers.measured: nemotron-3-ultra 53/57, 0 rate limits in 210K tokens (slow: median 14 s)
providers.plain: You get 40 requests a minute, but the total daily amount is not published.

providers.name: Mistral La Plateforme (Experiment plan)
providers.source: community list; needs phone verification and opting in to data training

providers.name: Mistral Codestral

limits.codestral: listed as 30 req/min, 2,000 req/day; we measured a burst limit after 3-4 calls/min ('reset after 3s')

providers.name: OpenRouter (:free models)
